title: Seismic Fractal Analysis (SFA): Framework for Precision-Calibrated Dimensional Inference
description: A comprehensive Python framework for performing precision-calibrated fractal dimension analysis of earthquake hypocenters. This software resolves the geometric projection and Bayesian saturation paradoxes in seismology through a Triple-Validation Framework (KL Divergence, Boundary Concentration, Scale Invariance). Includes modules for 3D correlation integral calculation, Bayesian D3 inference with suppression of saturation artifacts, and independent network quality calibration.
